Subject: Introducing the Summit: Our Longest-Lasting Insulation Yet
Preview: 750 ml. 24-hour cold. 12-hour hot. Built for the long days out there.
Body: You know what a long day on the trail asks of your gear. The Summit Insulated Bottle was built with that in mind.

The Summit holds 750 ml — enough to carry what you need without the extra weight slowing you down. It's double-wall stainless steel, which keeps drinks cold for 24 hours and hot for 12 hours. That's the longest-lasting insulation we have made.

It's not built for everything. It won't replace a filtration system, and it's not meant for technical mountaineering kits where every gram is negotiated down to the decimal. But for a full day out — a ridge traverse, a long trail run, a basecamp morning — it holds its temperature when cheaper options have long since given up.

The Summit. 750 ml. Double-wall stainless steel. 24-hour cold retention, 12-hour hot retention. Our longest-lasting insulation, in a bottle that fits your pack.
